title: Exactness of coordinate induced maps on inverse limits
statement: For coordinatewise short exact sequences of towers, induced maps on inverse limits are injective and exact in the middle; if the kernel tower has surjective transitions, the induced map on quotients is surjective.

proof.text: Use injectivity and exactness in each coordinate, uniqueness of coordinate preimages, and recursive correction of lifts using surjective kernel transitions.

lean.statement: theorem tower_limit_exact_of_coordinate_maps (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} R) (G : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R) (H : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{t} R) (α : ∀ n : ℕ, F.obj (Opposite.op n) →ₗ[R] G.obj (Opposite.op n)) (β : ∀ n : ℕ, G.obj (Opposite.op n) →ₗ[R] H.obj (Opposite.op n)) (hshort : ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Injective (α n) ∧ Function.Exact (α n) (β n) ∧ Function.Surjective (β n)) (U : ↑(limit F) →ₗ[R] ↑(limit G)) (V : ↑(limit G) →ₗ[R] ↑(limit H)) (hU : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ↑(limit F)), limit.π G (Opposite.op n) (U x) = α n (limit.π F (Opposite.op n) x)) (hV : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ↑(limit G)), limit.π H (Opposite.op n) (V x) = β n (limit.π G (Opposite.op n) x)) : Function.Injective U ∧ Function.Exact U V ∧ ((∀ n : ℕ, Function.Surjective (F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n 1)).op)) → Function.Surjective V)
